verdict.rationale: A state employment agency's online services (eServices, EAMS) could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or chatbot, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only shows form-based portals, videos, PDF and mail filing, and 404 probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI. Nothing shows the product can be operated with natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
